text:
mina: Hey team, I'm in Barcelona (Poblenou) for a client dinner on Thursday 7pm. Need tapas-ish spots nearby that's not too loud and has veg + seafood options. Any favs?
jorge: Xiringuito Escribà is beachside and nice for seafood, but it's a bit touristy and pricier.
li: Els Pescadors in Poblenou is classic and quieter, great for paella and tapas.
sam: If you want super casual and quick, La Paradeta is seafood market-style, you pick and they cook.
paula: For veggie-friendly tapas, Teresa Carles or Flax & Kale are more vegetarian-forward (a short cab away).
mina: Client prefers quieter table and decent wifi. Also one person is gluten-free.
jorge: Els Pescadors can do GF on request. Call ahead for a corner table.
li: Xiringuito can be windy/noisy in high season, but early seating at 7pm is usually fine.
sam: If you want trendy but quieter, try Can Dendê (small, reservations recommended).
mina: Poll: react with emoji: :beach_umbrella: Xiringuito, :fish: Els Pescadors, :shell: La Paradeta, :leafy_green: Veg-forward (Teresa/Flax), :question: Other/DM me
